data.title: 在原七海 · 织到一半的围巾
data.description: 七海把织到一半的围巾摊在膝上，数了数刚完成的针脚。发现漏了一针，她拆回去一点，重新织好。
data.action: knitting a scarf while seated on a sofa
data.promptProse: Seated comfortably on a plush, patterned living room sofa, Nanami focuses intently on knitting a soft, woolly scarf spread across her lap. Baskets of colorful yarn skeins sit on the floor beside her, while soft afternoon light streams in, highlighting the intricate texture of the yarn and the peaceful, domestic setting of her home.
data.animaCaption: She knits a scarf laid across her lap.
